transport: WebSocket. Text frames carry one JSON message each; binary frames carry audio.

mic.layout: tag u8, then PCM s16le mono at hello.sample_rate

speech.layout: tag u8, utterance u32 little-endian, then PCM s16le mono at welcome.speech_rate

hello.doc: First message on a new socket.

ping.doc: Round trip probe; the server answers with pong.

playback.doc: What the speaker actually played. played_ms is audio played of this utterance.

pong.doc: Answer to ping. server_ms is the session audio clock.

transcript.doc: Recognised text of the user's current turn. text is the whole hypothesis, not a diff.

prepare.doc: The user's turn is over and she is about to speak (T2 body cue).

speak_start.doc: Speech audio for this utterance follows in binary frames.

speak_text.doc: One clause of the utterance, in the order it is spoken.

lipsync.doc: Word timings from the synthesizer, relative to the utterance's first sample.

speak_end.doc: No more audio for this utterance.

stop_audio.doc: Drop any queued audio of this utterance now.

turn_report.doc: Timings of a finished turn on the session audio clock (ms of mic audio received). For logs and replays.

error.doc: Something failed. retryable means the next turn may work.
